[{"insert":"DB/KB Front Rack RFESS Progression

Back to the rear foot elevated split squat with the load in the front rack position and reps dropping to 6. The front rack keeps the torso more upright than a suitcase or goblet hold and increases the core demand to maintain position. Use your Week 3 working weights as a starting point and increase where you can. All sets are prescribed at RPE 8 to 10.  Push hard on every set.
"}]

Loading Note:
Perform 2-3 warmup sets. Set 1-4, aim for RPE 7,8,9,10 respectively. The accumulated fatigue from each set should make the next set harder. This means you may increase weight OR you may keep the weight the same to match the prescribed RPE.
